note: Replaces the earlier invented 'media-types.json'. In the real builder there is no standalone 'pick your media types' step - media/format choices are per-module questions instead (see the reference builder interview spec, 'module_questions'). Each question is asked only when its appliesTo module(s) are in the selected cart.
selectionRule: Keep a question when any id in its appliesTo intersects the chosen module cart; ask in fixed registry order.

questions.label: Main focus
questions.note: Deliberately no free-text 'other' - matching is deterministic tag scoring.

notAskedAsQuestions.reading_plan: Book picker (up to 4 books) + chapters-per-day stepper on a dedicated screen, not an interview question.
notAskedAsQuestions.bible_reader: Book picker (up to 2 books) + feature toggles (audio, highlights, notes, study_notes) on a dedicated screen, not an interview question.
